module.purpose: Provides the database query used to retrieve a complete booking aggregate before deletion, including associated user, calendar, payment, event-type, workflow, and meeting data.
module.summary: This module defines a Prisma-backed lookup that requires either booking identifier components and throws when no matching record exists. It selects the booking fields and related records needed by cancellation or deletion logic, including calendar credentials, external references, payment details, event ownership, team context, recurrence, hosts, workflows, and attendee responses. It also exports the inferred result type for downstream consumers.
module.businessContext: Supports booking cancellation and deletion across calendar, payment, scheduling, and workflow integrations. Failure prevents safe cleanup of bookings and their associated meetings, reminders, and external calendar records.
classes: BookingToDelete (~L120-120): Represents the selected booking aggregate required by cancellation and deletion workflows.
functions: getBookingToDelete (~L5-118): Retrieves a booking and related scheduling data needed for safe deletion.
